integrity: Analytic limiting proof and a standalone finite-regime checker supplied; numerical tests are not infinite theorems. Publication priority and independent mathematical audit are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-time, common symmetric two-state Markov diffusivity; distinct positive D values, lambda_N tends to infinity, and conditional independence of tracer Brownian motions. Asymmetric or non-Markov switching and first passage are not addressed. General published random-environment extreme value theory may offer implicit coverage; complete text of one broad stochastic-diffusivity source was unavailable.
title: A Gaussian–Gumbel crossover and logistic bilateral cancellation in a shared switching-diffusivity gas
